mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high consumer spending and low unemployment, a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 12-month MA but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that leads the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (annualized) but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, it indicates a weakening labor market without accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of cases.
